summary: Verified Arabic ERP page-navigation and bot↔page wiring per request. Page navigation: all 12 sidebar pages render (screenshot confirms /customers and /technicians load real cards despite a low innerText counter false-flagging them; Dashboard hit an intermittent 502). Bot navigation: CustomerCard never appeared because the bot's customer search returned 'لم أجد عميل مطابقاً' for 'محمد' even though customer records with 'محمد' exist on /customers — so the bot navigation card→/customer/<id> route could NOT be exercised. Deep-link /operations?focus=<id> did NOT auto-expand the target operation (operation-card-expanded-<id> never rendered). Reactive binding for customer creation WORKED — created 'ربط تجريبي' via bot appeared on /customers without manual refresh.

critical.endpoint: intermittent 502 from backend (e.g., GET / customers list after burst, dashboard initial load)
critical.issue: Sporadic 502 'Failed to load resource' observed during the session — caused Dashboard initial render to look empty and customers fetch to throw AxiosError 502

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /operations?focus=<valid-uuid> does NOT auto-expand the operation card. The element [data-testid="operation-card-expanded-<uuid>"] never appears (waited >4s after route). The 'عرض/معاينة العملية' bot deep-link is therefore broken end-to-end.

Query 'ابحث عن عميل محمد' returned bubble 'لم أجد عميل مطابقاً، تأكد من الاسم أو رقم الجوال/اللوحة' although the /customers page clearly contains customers named 'احمد محمد العميل'. Search appears to require exact name match / not fuzzy-match Arabic substrings. Because no CustomerCard renders, the navigation-card→/customer/<id> assertion (card-action-CustomerCard-open) could not be verified.

Even though 'ربط تجريبي' was eventually created and reflected on /customers (reactive binding works ✓), the assistant first showed a transient error bubble 'تعذّر التنفيذ مؤقتاً. حاول مرة أخرى أو صِغ الطلب بشكل أوضح' and no explicit '✅ تم' success bubble was visible. UX is confusing — success bubble should appear when create succeeds.

integration_issues.flow: Bot navigation card → page route (ترابط البوت)
integration_issues.issue: Could not be verified because CustomerCard never returned for the searched query. Recommend either (a) seeding/using an exact-match query like the full customer name returned by /api/customers, or (b) fixing fuzzy Arabic search in card_builder/intent layer.

Operations.jsx skip-first-run effect or query-param read is not triggering expand-and-scroll. Verify the effect dependency on location.search and that initial render does not 'skip' on first mount when ?focus= is already present (skip-first-run might be eating the very mount we need).

action_items: FIX: /operations?focus=<id> must auto-expand and scroll to that operation on first mount. Review skip-first-run logic in Operations.jsx — when the URL already contains ?focus= on first render, the focus must NOT be skipped.

FIX: Bot customer search should match Arabic substrings (e.g., 'محمد' should match 'احمد محمد العميل'). Verify search query against backend /api/customers filter (likely case/whitespace-sensitive or only matches name prefix).
INVESTIGATE: Sporadic 502 from backend during navigation; check supervisor backend logs for crashes/timeouts.
UX: After successful create-customer via assistant, render a '✅ تم' success bubble even if a transient error bubble was shown earlier.
critical_code_review_comments: Operations.jsx focus deep-link is silently failing — add a console.debug + e2e test to guarantee the expand path on direct URL load.

Sidebar children (e.g., /print) route to /print but App.js doesn't define /print route — it falls through to '*' Dashboard. Sidebar has child item path '/print' (line 116) but App.js has only /quotations and /document-print etc. — confirm /print is a valid route (verify after fixes).

success_rate.frontend: Page-load 12/12 visually rendered (Dashboard hit 502 once); Bot↔page wiring 1/3 verified (reactive OK; bot-nav and deep-link FAILED)

seed_data_creation: Created temp customer 'ربط تجريبي' via bot, attempted cleanup via 'احذف العميل ربط تجريبي' + approve. Cleanup approval was clicked but a 502 occurred during execute — main agent should verify if the test customer still exists on /customers and delete manually if so.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When testing CustomerCard navigation, first call backend /api/customers to get an exact full Arabic name, then send that exact name to the assistant — fuzzy 'محمد' substring did not match. For deep-link test, after fix, retry /operations?focus=<uuid>; the assertion is the appearance of [data-testid=operation-card-expanded-<uuid>] within 5s. Reactive binding via finance:updated event works correctly. Page-nav low-text false-negatives are a test-detection artifact — pages do load (visible in screenshot).
rca of the issue: Deep-link: most likely Operations.jsx has a 'skip-first-run' ref that is consuming the very initial mount where ?focus= is set, so the expand effect never runs on direct URL load. Recommendation: when the route is entered with an existing ?focus= param, do NOT skip on first run — only skip subsequent collapse-reset cycles. Bot customer search: backend search likely uses startsWith or exact match instead of contains/ILIKE on Arabic name field.
